name: Kokoro TTS
author: MASH2RAFI
description: Local text-to-speech with the Kokoro-82M model: type or paste text, pick one of 41 voices, stream speech through PipeWire, optionally save WAV files. Settings for voice, speed, volume, GPU/CPU, saving, and idle unloading are kept in ~/.config/omarchy/kokoro-tts.json.

barWidget.description: Click to open the text-to-speech app; right-click to speak the selected text.
